_note: Intra-Near-Eastern blend (Egyptian + Ethiopian): a Nubian/Meroitic-type civ on the desert-savanna frontier. Backbone = Egyptian (phonology, Per-/Niut-/Ta- toponyms, sa-filiation, divine-kingship titles); overlay = Ge'ez (amba and debr features, monastery/saint veneration, Ras/Negus frontier titles, -a endings). civ = feudal. Even split Lawful/Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Egyptian/Ge'ez registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are SECOND-ORDER phoneme-morphs: the Agrippan canon as morphed into Punic (Barcan) trade-forms, then drifted again through Egyptian phonology — the shared Punic-cognate ancestor of the family.

phonology.palette: Egyptian backbone (dj, tj, kh, h, sh, q; l->r; v->w; endings -aa/-et) with Ge'ez overlay touches (-a endings, amba/debr, emphatics); theophoric stems are second-order morphs of the Punic forms (Tjulraa-, Argandja-, Warlandja-, Riarath-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; clusters dj/tj/kh; long -aa; gemination in the Ge'ez overlay; stress varies.

morphology.patronymic_form: filiation 'sa' (son of) with Ge'ez 'walda-X' as a secondary form; theophoric given names on morphed god-stems; no inherited surname (filiation + epithet); nobles a per/bet house.
morphology.compounding_rule: construct: Per-[god] (house/temple of), Niut-[god] (city of), Debra-[god|feature] (mount of, Ge'ez); quality + feature: Kemu-niut (black-land city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (Egyptian backbone; divine-kingship and nomarch bureaucracy, with Ge'ez Ras/Negash titles for the savanna frontier-lords, as narrative flavor)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Egyptian backbone, ascending. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom; Per-aa (the Great House) empire. Ge'ez overlay: the southern savanna marches are styled in Ge'ez (a frontier-lord may be hailed Negash or Ras). (Rank titles are the real Egyptian/Ge'ez register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); Iry-pat (hereditary heir)

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + filiation (sa-X) and/or earned epithet; the savanna nobility may use the Ge'ez walda-X / a debr-house; no inherited surname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: river-valley officials append office-titles; the savanna-frontier nobility use Ge'ez filiation + monastery-house.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names from the morphed deity-names + an Egyptian element (X-hotep = X-is-content, X-mose = X-is-born, Mery-X = beloved-of-X, Sa-X = son-of-X) or a Ge'ez element (Gabra-X = servant-of-X, overlay). e.g. Tjulraa-hotep, Mery-Argandja, Gabra-Tjulraa.

religion._note: Deity-names are second-order phoneme-morphs: the canonical Agrippan pantheon as morphed into Punic (Barcan) trade-forms, then drifted again through Egyptian phonology (l->r; v->w; -us/-a -> -aa/-et; dj/tj/kh) with a Ge'ez monastic coloring — never real Egyptian, Nubian, or Ethiopian holy names. Lawful/Neutral; a solar divine-kingship cult with a strong funerary and monastery (debr) overlay.
religion.the_one: Atjaraa (< Punic Atharon < Aeternus; the hidden distant maker)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power (the Chaotic 13 for this Lawful-leaning realm) keeps its morphed name + its own portfolio epithet (distinct per power; framed as kin of the great serpent Hefau): Maraxus -> Marakhej the City-Burner; Lusanto -> Lusandja the Coin-Serpent; Vacidus -> Wakedja the Devouring Hefau.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) or Debr (monastery, Ge'ez overlay) of [power]: 'the Per-netjer of Tjulraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified-just dead (akhu) and god-kings, plus Ge'ez-style monastery saints (Qiddus [name]), venerated at tomb-temples and rock-hewn debr.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tjulraa: sun-disc above the feather of right-order
holy_symbol_motifs.Riarath: a sheltering vulture-mother over the ankh

banks_patterns.ships: solar-barque and river-trader names: 'Barque of Tjulraa', 'Beloved of the Itru'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [god] Division / the [name] Companies: 'the Division of Warlandja'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: tomb-pyramids of the god-kings and ruined rock-debr: 'the Tomb of Per-aa [name]', 'the fallen Debr of [name]'
